title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval of a Firm Transportation Agreement with VA Boston Healthcare System - West Roxbury Division.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreements. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the agreements ar competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners Keating, Vasington, Sullivan and Manning. (GC 01-06, GC 01-07 and GC 01-08).
